title: STAObservation
description: OGC SensorThings API v1.1 Observation entity. One individual measurement result posted to POST /FROST-Server/v1.1/Observations. The Datastream @iot.id link implicitly carries Thing, Sensor, ObservedProperty, and unit.

resultTime.description: When the result was recorded. May be null.

result.description: Observed value. Type follows Datastream.observationType: number (OM_Measurement), string (OM_Category), boolean (OM_Truth).

resultQuality.description: Quality flag (simple string) or ISO 19157 DQ_Element array.

validTime.description: ISO-8601 interval during which this result is valid.

parameters.description: Traceability context (not part of the phenomenon).

Datastream.description: Datastream reference. @iot.id resolved at runtime from the domain master data.

FeatureOfInterest.description: Optional. If omitted FROST auto-derives from the Thing's Location.
